game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling heat shields into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: In Fire Shrine, repeat each round: Sort falling heat shields into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ash ranger ahead. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the obsidian gate by solving code steps involving sorted_ok that move the ash ranger forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the obsidian gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Fire Shrine'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Fire Shrine.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
